newsitem.title: USA: Republic to buy 2 Calif. solid waste cos.
newsitem.headline: Republic to buy 2 Calif. solid waste cos.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire to acquire two solid waste companies in southern California, Consolidated Disposal Service Inc of Santa Fe Springs and Bel-Art Environmental Services Inc of Long Beach.
Republic also announced that it has closed on the acquisition of PSI Waste Systems, Inc of Twin Falls, Idaho.

The acquisitions will be accounted for as a pooling of interests and are subject to certain conditions, including government approval. The aggregate acquisition price for the three companies is $65 million, payable in Republic common stock.
The principals in each of the three companies will sign long-term employment agreements with Republic and will continue in their respective roles.

"The acquisitions of Consolidated and Bel-Art add significantly to Republic's solid foundation in southern California and provide a great strategic fit with Taormina Industries." said Harris W. Hudson, vice chairman of Republic Industries and chairman of Republic's Solid Waste and Security Services Division. "PSI Waste Systems opens a new market for us in Idaho and northern Arizona. We are extremely pleased to welcome each of these companies into Republic and we look forward to expanding our businesses together."
